scope: Six authorized bounded refinements: game-card row alignment, booking vocabulary, compact consent, PS-mark icon, desktop-sized mobile CTA, short tariff delivery badges; plus requested centered missing-game panel and critical selection/fixture safety.
evidenceLimits: Tested final packaged WordPress locally in Chromium, including actual touch tap/click and keyboard. Physical iPhone Safari has not been verified.

Two narrow success POST fixtures (one per language) were intercepted before transmission. No real order or email was sent; backend confirmation semantics were checked read-only in installed/source/ZIP-identical PHP.
Screenshot blur removes incidental focus only for visual capture; focus/prefill/keyboard/Escape/return checks execute separately before or after each capture. Native FAQ/legal pages were GET-only.
This is targeted release acceptance for requested refinements, not a new broad audit of unrelated areas.
